food.excerpt: A step-by-step guide to making crisp, golden mixed bhajiya — the classic Indian street snack of batter-fried potato, brinjal, chilli, and bread.
food.image_caption: A platter of assorted bhajiya including potato, brinjal, chilli, and bread fritters served with green chutney. The crisp gram flour-coated fritters are a staple street food across Gujarat and Maharashtra.
food.nri_angle: For Indian diaspora families craving monsoon-season comfort food, bhajiya with chai is the ultimate taste of home.

food.title: ITC's Dakshin Crowned India's Best South Indian Restaurant at National Awards
food.excerpt: The iconic Mumbai restaurant beat five other nominees at the Zee Zest Unlimit Awards 2026, as Kerala and South Indian cuisine enjoy a global moment.
food.nri_angle: Kerala and South Indian cuisine are gaining unprecedented global recognition, with diaspora restaurants in New York and Leeds earning top honors.

food.title: India Moves to Ban Fake Paneer as States Crack Down on Dairy Fraud
food.excerpt: FSSAI plans to outright prohibit analogue paneer while Maharashtra has already imposed a one-year state-wide ban, with 35% of tested samples failing safety standards.
food.nri_angle: Affects the quality of paneer available across India, a staple food for the Indian diaspora visiting or sending for family back home.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Maharashtra FDA Suspends Domino's and Five Other Eatery Licences Over Food Safety Violations
food.excerpt: A statewide enforcement drive found cockroach infestations, expired ingredients, and missing safety documentation across six food establishments in Maharashtra.
food.image_caption: A food inspector examines a restaurant kitchen. Maharashtra's FDA has suspended licences of six eateries including major fast food chains over serious food safety violations.
food.nri_angle: The crackdown on major food chains raises awareness for Indian Americans who frequent these brands during visits to India and highlights the growing push for food safety enforcement in the country.

food.title: Family-Run Indian Restaurant Near Newark Wins National Best Restaurant Award
food.excerpt: The Ashiana in North Muskham takes home Best Restaurant of the Year at the Curry Life Awards, adding to a growing list of East Midlands honours.
food.nri_angle: The Ashiana reflects the enduring legacy of Bangladeshi families in Britain's curry industry, representing a model of diaspora entrepreneurship built on traditional flavours and personalised service.

food.title: From School Dropout to IPO: How Sathish Kumar Built the Rs 10,000 Crore Milky Mist Dairy Empire
food.excerpt: The Erode teenager who taught himself to make paneer is now taking his dairy company public with a Rs 1,553 crore offering
food.nri_angle: Milky Mist's IPO and national expansion highlight how a small-town Indian dairy brand built on paneer — a staple in diaspora kitchens worldwide — is entering public markets.

food.title: How a Bengaluru Startup Turns Fruit Waste Into Ingredients That Replace Microplastics
food.excerpt: BacAlt Biosciences ferments agricultural waste into biopolymers that can replace the synthetic additives found in shampoos, toothpaste, and cleaning products.
food.nri_angle: An Indian startup addressing the global microplastics problem through biotechnology, with implications for India's speciality ingredients industry and export ambitions.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: Why Trader Joe's $2.99 Frozen Garlic Naan Has Become a Cult Favorite
food.excerpt: At four pieces for under three dollars, the frozen flatbread has earned praise from Indian food lovers and budget shoppers alike — and it outranks most of the store's other Indian offerings.
food.image_caption: Trader Joe's frozen garlic naan, sold in packs of four for $2.99. The product has earned a devoted following among Indian food fans and budget-conscious shoppers.
food.nri_angle: A convenient, affordable version of a staple Indian bread that diaspora families keep stocked for quick meals.

food.title: Sawan Fasting? This No-Onion, No-Garlic Paneer Sabji Is Ready in 20 Minutes
food.excerpt: A rich, creamy paneer curry that follows sattvic cooking principles for Shravan fasting — using whole spices, tomatoes, and cashew paste instead of the usual onion-garlic base.
food.image_caption: A traditional paneer dish, a staple of Indian vegetarian cooking. The no-onion, no-garlic paneer sabji is popular during the Sawan fasting period observed by Hindus.
food.nri_angle: Shravan fasting is widely observed by Hindu diaspora families, who often struggle to find sattvic recipes that are both authentic and practical for weeknight cooking abroad.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

food.title: How a Bengaluru Couple's Homesickness Built India's Hottest Dosa Brand
food.excerpt: Akhil Iyer and Shriya Narayan turned a craving for Davangere-style benne dosa into a Rs 350 crore brand with three Mumbai outlets, a Delhi presence, and billionaire investor interest.
food.image_caption: Benne, the fast-growing dosa chain founded by Bengaluru couple Akhil Iyer and Shriya Narayan. The brand has expanded from a single 275-square-foot Bandra outlet to multiple cities, with a valuation of Rs 350 crore.
food.nri_angle: Benne dosa is a Bengaluru staple now expanding nationally, part of a broader wave of regional Indian food brands gaining mainstream attention and investor interest.
food.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Travel Influencer Left With Over 100 Bed Bug Bites After One Night at Budget Hotel
travel.excerpt: Hannah Stephenson's viral TikTok documenting bleeding welts from a Travelodge stay in Cambridge, England, reignites scrutiny of bed bug prevention in the hospitality industry.
travel.nri_angle: Indian diaspora travelers frequently book budget hotel chains like Travelodge in the UK for family visits and business trips, making bed bug awareness directly relevant.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Andhra Pradesh Pours ₹98 Crore Into Suryalanka Beach in Push to Build India's Eastern Goa
travel.excerpt: A Swadesh Darshan 2.0 project, luxury tent cities, beach shacks, and ultra-luxury backwater cruises are transforming Bapatla district's coastline into a major tourism hub.
travel.image_caption: A fishing boat near Suryalanka Beach in Bapatla district, Andhra Pradesh. The state government is investing ₹98 crore to develop the beach into a major tourism destination.
travel.nri_angle: NRIs from Andhra Pradesh will find a significantly upgraded coastal tourism experience at Suryalanka, with the state investing heavily to compete with Goa and Kerala as beach destinations.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Canada Airports Launch Free Flow Transit, Letting International Passengers Skip Border Checks
travel.excerpt: Toronto Pearson, Vancouver, and Montréal-Trudeau now let connecting international travelers bypass customs entirely, saving up to 60 minutes on layovers.
travel.nri_angle: Indian travelers routing through Canadian airports to the US will benefit from faster connections, especially on the popular Delhi/Mumbai-Toronto-US corridor.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Japan Orders Mass Evacuations as Typhoon Dolphin Cancels Over 500 Flights
travel.excerpt: The Category 1 storm is bearing down on southwestern Japan with 144 kph winds, forcing 260,000 to evacuate and shuttering Toyota factories. China's eastern coast braces for landfall within days.
travel.image_caption: Typhoon Dolphin approaching southwestern Japan on Friday. The Category 1 storm has forced the evacuation of nearly 260,000 residents across Kagoshima and Okinawa prefectures.
travel.nri_angle: Indian nationals and diaspora travellers in Japan or eastern China should monitor advisories as the storm disrupts flights, rail and ferry services during peak summer travel season.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

travel.title: Iberia to Chase the Solar Eclipse at 35,000 Feet in a Historic First
travel.excerpt: The Spanish airline will fly an Airbus A321XLR above the clouds on August 12 to observe Spain's first total solar eclipse in over a century, livestreaming the event globally via Starlink.
travel.image_caption: An Iberia aircraft. The Spanish flag carrier is planning a special flight to chase the solar eclipse at 35,000 feet.
travel.nri_angle: For the Indian diaspora in Europe, the eclipse offers a rare celestial spectacle visible from Spain, with Valencia, Zaragoza, and Barcelona all in the path of totality — an experience not seen from the Iberian Peninsula since 1912.
travel.author: Diaspora Desk

carousel.title: ICE Plans to Spend Up to $20 Million on Electrical Shock Gloves for Agents
carousel.excerpt: The Department of Homeland Security posted a contract notice for G.L.O.V.E. devices that deliver up to 380 volts on skin contact, drawing swift condemnation from civil rights groups.
carousel.nri_angle: Adds to the escalating enforcement environment facing immigrant communities including South Asian populations in the US.

carousel.title: Near-Total Lunar Eclipse to Create Blood Moon Visible Across Americas on August 28
carousel.excerpt: A deep partial lunar eclipse will cover 96% of the moon later this month, producing a striking red 'blood moon' effect visible across North and South America, Europe, and Africa — the best lunar eclipse until 2028.
carousel.nri_angle: The lunar eclipse will be visible across the United States, making it a shared viewing event for Indian diaspora families. Lunar eclipses hold cultural and religious significance in Indian traditions.

carousel.title: Amar Upadhyay Returns as Mihir Virani in Kyunki 2 After 14-Week Absence That Sank Ratings
carousel.excerpt: The actor's exit dropped the show from No. 1 to No. 5 on the charts. After fee negotiations and a massive fan campaign, Mihir is back in Shanti Niketan.
carousel.nri_angle: Kyunki remains a touchstone for the Indian diaspora — the original series was a shared cultural experience across NRI households, and the reboot is drawing the same cross-generational audience.

carousel.title: Hardik Pandya's Gujarat Titans Return Falls Through Over Captaincy Demand
carousel.excerpt: The all-rounder reportedly wanted to rejoin his former franchise but insisted on leading the side, a non-starter with Shubman Gill as GT's settled captain.
carousel.nri_angle: Hardik Pandya's IPL future is a major talking point for cricket-obsessed Indian diaspora fans tracking the trade drama ahead of IPL 2027.

carousel.title: Intel Honors Two Indian American Professors With Outstanding Researcher Awards for AI Work
carousel.excerpt: Purdue's Vijay Raghunathan and Georgia Tech's Visvesh Sathe, both IIT alumni, recognized for contributions to energy-efficient computing and AI hardware innovation.
carousel.image_caption: Intel has recognized Indian American professors Vijay Raghunathan of Purdue and Visvesh Sathe of Georgia Tech with its 2025 Outstanding Researcher Awards for AI and semiconductor work.
carousel.nri_angle: Two Indian American professors, both IIT Bombay graduates, receive Intel's prestigious research awards for AI and semiconductor innovations at leading U.S. universities.

carousel.excerpt: South Korean shares jumped 4.4% and Japan's Nikkei gained 1.9% after US consumer prices rose just 0.1% in July, dampening expectations of a September Fed rate increase.
carousel.nri_angle: Global market rally on tame US inflation data relevant to diaspora investors with US, Asian, and Indian market exposure.
